lcelection
MLC Election 2026 ki 8 siton ke aa rahe natijon men bara phaisla samne aaya hai. tirhut shikshak nirvachan kshetr se rashtriy jantantrik gathbandhan (NDA) samarthit pratyashi narendr prasad sinh ne shandar jit darj ki hai. matganna prakriya puri hone ke bad aadhikarik rup se vijyi ghoshit kie gae narendr prasad sinh ne mujaphpharpur matganna kendr ke bahar midiya ko sanbodhit karte hue apni is jit ko endie karyakartaon ke kare parishram aur rajy sarkar ke shikshak-hitaishi nitiyon ki jit karar diya hai.
